posts.title: Nobody Was Convicted. The Licences Stayed Cancelled.
posts.description: The 2G scam, read from the actual documents: what the auditor estimated, what two courts decided, what a tribunal in The Hague added in 2025, and exactly what is still pending as of August 2026.

posts.title: The condition nobody quotes
posts.description: Ambedkar called civil disobedience the Grammar of Anarchy. He also said exactly when that judgement applies, and almost nobody quotes that part.

posts.title: The Trading Machine, One Slide At A Time
posts.description: An animated onboarding deck for new joiners in quant trading: front office to back office, multicast to matching engine, FIX to FPGA. Fourteen slides plus a four-slide appendix, every acronym you'll hear in week one, and what changes when your desk is in India.
